Floww — Open-Source AI Financial Engine

An open-source personal finance engine featuring Google Gemini OCR and full release on Web & Android with latest APK download.

Floww eliminates the tedious friction of manual expense tracking by converting messy receipts, invoices, and bank statements into structured intelligence. Engineered with Next.js 15, PostgreSQL, and Google Gemini, Floww is 100% open-sourced, deployed live at floww.vercel.app, and rolled out on Android with a direct APK download.

> Key Architectural Breakthroughs

📱

Android Rollout & Mobile Engineering

Floww is officially rolled out on Android with a standalone APK. Users get instant camera receipt parsing on the go, biometric lock security, offline transaction caching, and seamless background cloud synchronization.

🌐

100% Open-Source Architecture

The entire Floww codebase is public on GitHub. Developers can self-host their own financial engine, customize categorization prompts, spin up private database instances with Prisma and Docker, and contribute new features.

🤖

Universal Document Intelligence & Agent Floww

Using Google Gemini's multimodal vision, Floww parses crumpled paper receipts, salary slips, and multi-page PDFs in seconds. Coupled with Agent Floww, an in-app RAG assistant, users can query their finances in natural language.

📬

Automated Gmail & E-Receipt Sync

Floww links securely with Gmail via OAuth 2.0 to scan for order receipts, payment confirmations, and bank alerts, automatically categorizing transactions without lifting a finger.

● Mobile Engineering & Release

Android Rollout & APK Deployment

While Floww originated as an ultra-fast Next.js web application, expense logging is inherently physical. The latest Android release delivers:

  • Instant Camera-to-OCR: Snap physical receipts directly from the Android camera and stream image bytes to Gemini API in under a second.
  • Offline-First Transaction Staging: Queue receipt scans locally when network connectivity is poor; background workers automatically synchronize with PostgreSQL once reconnected.
  • Biometric Privacy Mode: Mask currency amounts with a single tap or biometric toggle for secure usage in public spaces.
  • Standalone APK Distribution: Instantly installable on any Android device without store restrictions.
⬇ Download Floww APK (v2.0.1)
● AI Architecture

Universal Document Intelligence & Agent Floww

Most finance apps require tedious manual logging. Floww changes this paradigm:

  • Multimodal OCR: Extracts merchant names, totals, line items, and tax categories from receipts, invoices, pay slips, and multi-page statements.
  • Agent Floww: In-app conversational finance assistant powered by RAG that understands your spending patterns and gives clear answers to natural-language questions.
  • Dynamic Health Score: Live financial health calculation derived from income-to-spend ratios, budget limits, and savings adherence.
